The other swung a [broom]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="broom · n. 金雀花；扫帚; 扫除; 桩顶开花或开裂"}, its [besom]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="besom · n. 扫帚"} head worn almost flat, then switched to a [brush]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="brush · n. 刷子；画笔；毛笔；争吵; 刷；画; 刷；擦过；掠过"} to work the grime out of the [bench]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bench · n. 长凳；工作台；练习台；运动员休息区；替补队员席；法官；法官席；议员席; 把换下；罚下场；不让上场；仰…"} joints. A copper [tray]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tray · n. 盘子, 托盘; 文件盘"} nearby held small parts sorted by size: [tack]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tack · n. 大头钉，平头钉; 航向，换向；方法; 用平头钉钉; 附加，增补"}s, [stud]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="stud · n. 大头钉；饰纽；壁骨；种马; 散布；用许多饰钮等装饰; 种马的；为配种而饲养的"}s, and a folded strip of [tain]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tain · n. 薄锡板,锡箔"} that someone had peeled from an old mould.

By mid-morning the heavier work began. The [crane]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="crane · n. 鹤；吊车，起重机; 伸着脖子看；迟疑，踌躇; 用起重机起吊；伸长脖子"} swung a [crate]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="crate · n. 板条箱；篓; 将某物装入大木箱或板条箱中"} of raw ore over the furnace pit; the melt would leave a thick skin of [slag]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="slag · n. 矿渣；熔渣；炉渣; 使成渣；使变成熔渣; 变熔渣"} once it cooled. The afternoon belonged to finishing. Symbolic Opti…"} for lubricating the saw, and a curl of spare [cable]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cable · n. 巨缆, 钢索; 电缆; &amp; 给发电报, 打电报告诉 Cable凯布尔"}. By dusk the crew had loaded the finished pieces onto a flatbed, ready for the [rake]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="rake · n. 耙子; &amp; 以耙子耙平; 用耙子把…耙在一起；把…耙出来; 搜寻事实等; 向开枪扫射"} of morning light and whatever the next order required — though tonight they would [reap]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="reap · vt. &amp; 收割庄稼；收获; 获得"} the quiet satisfaction of a clean, emptied shop.

### The Craftsman's Workshop at First Light

Before the [diesel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="diesel · n. 柴油机；柴油；健康的身体; 内燃机传动的；供内燃机用的"} engine outside had time to warm up, the old craftsman was already at his bench. He pulled a worn [towel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="towel · n. 毛巾，手巾；纸巾; 用毛巾擦; 用毛巾擦干身体"} from the hook by the [faucet]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="faucet · n. 旋塞；插口"}, ran it under cold water, and wrung it out — a small ritual before the serious work began. The [drawer]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="drawer · n. 抽屉"} beside him held his most trusted instruments: a [chisel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chisel · vt. 欺骗；凿；雕，刻; 欺骗；凿；雕，刻; 凿子"} whose handle had been worn smooth by decades of use, a set of [gauges]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="gauges · n. 计量表，仪表；测量仪器; 计量；估计；修正"} for reading metal thickness, and a small [gimbal]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="gimbal · n. 万向节"} mount he'd salvaged from a broken [glider]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="glider · n. 滑翔机"} rigging years ago. Each tool had its place, and each place had its purpose.

The morning's main job was annealing a set of steel [blades]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="blades · n. 刀刃；扁叉；刀片"}. To [anneal]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="anneal · vt. 使退火，韧炼；锻炼; 退火；锻炼，磨练"} them properly, he'd heat each one to a deep orange glow, then let it cool slowly in the [bucket]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bucket · n. 铲斗；桶，水桶；一桶的量; 倾盆而下；颠簸着行进"} of fine sand on the floor. Beside it sat a rack of parts already [forged]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="forged 锻造的"} the previous day — rough, heavy things waiting to be refined. He used a [wedge]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="wedge · vt. 楔入；挤进；楔住; 楔入；挤进; 楔子；楔形物；导致分裂的东西"} to separate two pieces that had stuck together in the cooling tray, tapping it in with a mallet until he felt the seam give. A metal [funnel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="funnel · n. 漏斗；烟囱; 通过漏斗或烟囱等；使成漏斗形; 通过漏斗等；成漏斗形"} directed quench oil into a small trough without splashing, and a [damper]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="damper · n. 阻尼器；减震器；气闸"} on the furnace door let him control the airflow without opening it all the way.

By mid-morning he had shifted to lighter tasks. He spread a length of woven [fabric]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="fabric · n. 织物, 布; 构造, 组织"} across the worktable to protect the surface, then set out a row of [enamel]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="enamel · n. 搪瓷；珐琅；釉药; 瓷漆; 珐琅质; 涂瓷釉于；给…上瓷漆；给…上彩饰"}-coated hardware he needed to inspect for cracks.
